text: dsh-skill-manager 是面向 DSH Web 的 skill 管理插件，通过设置页、对话头部和新对话输入区接入管理界面，并在宿主注册 skill provider 与管理接口。它可以全局启用或禁用 skill、为工作区设置新对话默认集合、为当前会话选择可用 skill，并删除用户目录中的 skill。状态保存在 DSH_HOME 下的插件数据文件中。适合需要按项目或对话控制 skill 集合的 DSH 用户；不需要 API Key 或外部账号。

dsh-skill-manager manages skills in DSH Web. It supports global enable or disable, workspace defaults for new chats, per-conversation selection, and deletion of user skills. State is kept in DSH plugin data; no API key or external account is needed.
我想给不同工作区设定新对话默认加载的 skill。
怎么只让当前这次聊天使用我选的几个 skill？
想全局关掉某个 skill，但保留它的文件。
能在聊天开始前挑选要用的 skill 吗？
How can I choose which skills a new chat starts with for each workspace?
I want to disable a skill everywhere without removing its files.
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「全局启用与禁用」：切换全局 skill 可用状态；禁用项通过不可调用的影子条目从模型目录和用户触发列表隐藏，原 skill 文件保留。
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「工作区默认集合」：为工作区的新对话设为全部可用或仅允许所选 skill，作为新会话默认。
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「当前会话选择」：在对话头部或空白新对话区域打开选择器，设为跟随工作区、全部可用或自定义集合。
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「删除用户 skill」：删除位于 ~/.dsh/skills 或 ~/.agents/skills 下的用户 skill 文件或目录；其他来源不允许删除。
dsh-skill-manager 使用前须知：删除操作会永久移除用户 skill 文件；范围仅限 DSH_HOME/skills 或 DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills 下的用户 skill。
如何把某些 skill 设为这个工作区新对话的默认选项？
Can I manage skills from the chat header and keep project defaults separate?

dsh-skill-manager README · dsh-skill-manager：- **Pick skills BEFORE the conversation starts** — the new-chat screen shows a
  "对话 Skill" chip above the composer: follow the workspace default, enable
  everything, or choose exactly which skills this conversation may load, then
  save before typing the first message.
- **Global enable / disable** — switch any skill off or on everywhere. Disabled
  skills disappear from the model's session skill catalog, from the `/` input
  trigger, and cannot be loaded by the `skill` tool or the `/name` gesture.
  Their files are never touched, so re-enabling restores them instantly.
- **Per-workspace defaults for new conversations** — pick "all available" or
  "only these skills" per workspace in Settings → Skill 管理. New
  conversations in that workspace start with exactly that selection.
- **In-conversation management** — the `Skill` button in the conversation
  header shows the current chat's effective skill set and lets you follow the
  workspace default, enable everything, or choose exactly which skills this
  chat may load. The session catalog republishes automatically on the next
  message ("对话中管理skill").
- **Delete user skills** — permanentl

dsh-skill-manager README · How it works：The skill registry merges layers with the NEAREST scope winning a duplicate
name, and on the Web surface the filesystem provider is mounted by the agent
preset into the preset's STANDING scope layer. This plugin therefore registers
a shadow provider named `skill-manager` with rank 10 (below every shipped
provider rank) into each AGENT's own scope layer on `agent/created` — the
nearest layer of all — so its synthetic **non-invocable** candidates for every
effectively-disabled skill name always win that agent's catalog. The skill is
hidden from the model and the user without touching its files, and the
registration unwinds automatically when the agent is disposed.

dsh-skill-manager README · How it works：The management surface never uses the plain registry read path (an unscoped
`ctx.skills.list()` sees only the global layer — empty on the Web surface):
`listRealSkills()` walks every layer (global + standing + agent) directly, so
the settings page shows the real catalog with real descriptions, invocation
flags, and paths. The "selected mode" complement uses that same cross-layer
universe.

State lives in one small JSON document:
`<dshHome>/plugin-data/skill-manager/state.json`.

dsh-skill-manager README · Routes：| Method | Path | Body | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/plugins/dsh-skill-manager/state` | — | global disabled set, workspace defaults, session overrides |
| GET | `/plugins/dsh-skill-manager/skills?cwd=…` | — | full real catalog with invocation flags, path, deletable |
| POST | `/plugins/dsh-skill-manager/global` | `{ names }` | replace the global disabled set |
| POST | `/plugins/dsh-skill-manager/workspace` | `{ cwd, mode, selected }` | set a workspace's new-conversation default |
| POST | `/plugins/dsh-skill-manager/session` | `{ sessionId, mode, selected }` | override one conversation's skill set |
| POST | `/plugins/dsh-skill-manager/delete` | `{ name }` | delete a user skill |
dsh-skill-manager README · Routes：Mutating routes require the `x-dsh-skill-manager: 1` header (CSRF hardening).

dsh-skill-manager README · Build / install：Pack the artifact (the tarball root holds a `package/` directory):

```sh
tar -czf artifact.tgz package/
```

Install through the Harness plugin center, or manually: add the artifact as a
dependency of the profile's `package.json` (`"dsh-skill-manager":
"file:…/artifact.tgz"`), append `dsh-skill-manager` to `dsh.profile.bundles`,
run `pnpm install` in the profile directory, then restart Harness.

dsh-skill-manager README · Testing：The pure-logic suites (core, provider, state view, intro/detail) need nothing
but Node 22+:

```sh
node --test test/core.test.js test/provider.test.js test/stateview.test.js test/intro.test.js
```

The integration suite imports the harness's own `cordis` / `dsh-skill` /
`dsh-scope` packages, so point `DSH_HOST_NODE_MODULES` at a DeepSeek Harness
install's `node_modules/@deepseek-ai` directory first:

```sh

dsh-skill-manager README · Windows example：$env:DSH_HOST_NODE_MODULES = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\@deepseek-aidsh-desktop\resources\host\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
node --test test/integration.test.js
```

`test/compose-check.mjs` is a machine-specific offline check that composes the
live profile (`DSH_PROFILE`, `DSH_HOME` and `DSH_HOST_NODE_MODULES` can point
it at any profile) and asserts the `skill-manager` loader row is present.

dsh-skill-manager README · Skill frontmatter metadata：The UI shows two Chinese introductions per skill, both read from the skill's
own SKILL.md frontmatter (the `metadata` object passes through untouched and
is never rendered into the model-facing catalog):

```yaml
metadata:
  intro: <一句话中文简介，列表展示>
  detail: |-
    <详细中文介绍，详情弹窗展示：用途/适用场景/工作流程/典型触发语/产出物>

The bundled `skill-intro-writer` skill (see `docs/` or your `~/.dsh/skills`)
automates writing both fields whenever a new SKILL.md is generated.
